text: Risk management is a crucial process for any organization or project. It begins with identifying potential risks, which can range from financial problems and natural disasters to technological failures. After recognizing these threats, teams develop mitigation strategies to reduce their likelihood or impact, such as improving safety protocols or diversifying investments. However, no plan is perfect, so creating contingency plans is essential. These are backup actions to take if a risk actually occurs, ensuring the project can continue. Finally, monitoring is a continuous task; risks change over time, so regular reviews and updates keep the plan effective. Ultimately, good risk management reduces surprises and helps achieve goals with confidence.
